_doc: Jen Santulan listing batch template for fantastic-posters. Each entry generates one luxury-real-estate-style poster. Pass to: node generate.js --batch=path/to/this/file.json --quality=high. Per-listing cost: ~$0.17 at high quality. Budget envelope: 5 listings = $0.85, 10 listings = $1.70, 20 listings BLOCKED by guard (>$1 per-call ceiling — split into chunks).

listings.highlights: Mid-century modern, hillside views, original terrazzo floors, pool
listings._brief_template_used: Luxury real estate poster for {address}. {beds_baths}, {sqft} sqft, listed at {price}. Highlights: {highlights}. Mood: {mood}. Realtor: Jennifer Santulan @realestatewithjing. Style: editorial luxury, lifestyle-aspirational, no agents in frame, no MLS-photo aesthetic.

listings.highlights: Contemporary build, chef's kitchen, primary suite with walk-in, oversized lot

_batch_workflow: 1. Edit this file: replace EXAMPLE entries with real listings, add as many as needed.
2. Calculate cost BEFORE running: count listings × $0.17 (high quality).
3. If total > $1.00, split into chunks of ≤5 listings each.
